a_before_b.rationale: DataPerf and dcbench are specific data-centric benchmarking tools, but understanding how to evaluate model performance using general benchmarks and metrics does not require prior knowledge of these specific tools.

b_before_a.rationale: To meaningfully understand how DataPerf and dcbench assess dataset quality through model performance metrics, a learner must first understand the general concepts of evaluating model performance using benchmarks and metrics.
